drawdown errstate invalid/divide set to None or omitted: values unchanged, and numpy 2.5.3 raised no RuntimeWarning on a NaN wealth path (4 mutants).
replacing `or` with `and` on the non-finite guards in sharpe, sortino, and calmar still returns NaN via the later checks (3 mutants).

sort-key json.dumps sort_keys/separators/ensure_ascii=None/allow_nan mutants: set elements are hashable and do not become dicts, so sort_keys does not change order; a 1485-pair probe of lists and strings found no separator order flip; ensure_ascii=None matches False; allow_nan=None matches False; allow_nan=True is unreachable in _json_sort_key because non-finite floats are already None (19 mutants).
embargo_mask mut5: `embargo_bars <= 0` -> `<` — a zero-width embargo window masks nothing extra, matching the early all-True return.
embargo_mask mut10/11: `.get(block_end)` -> None/`.get(None)` falls through to the nearest-session lookup `min(keys, ...)`, which returns the same index whenever block_end is a session key.
overlaps mut10: `train_decision < test_start` -> `<=` is unobservable — at train_decision == test_start the second disjunct `train_decision >= test_start` already returns True.
purge_mask mut41/42: dropping or nil-ing `.get(t)` falls back to `bisect_left(keys, t)`, which returns the same index for every decision time present in session_index.
purge_mask mut58: `t < test_start` -> `<=` — at t == test_start the in_holdout check `test_lo <= i <= test_hi` already drops the row, so the mask is unchanged.
Empty-group raise is unreachable: `n < n_groups` raises first, so group bounds can never be empty (cv mut44-47, indices mut37-40 — message variants).
Path-incidence RuntimeError is unreachable: by_group construction always yields exactly n_paths ids (mut24-27 — message variants).
bounds `range(n_groups+1)` -> `+2` appends one extra bound element that group slicing never reads (cv mut36, indices mut23).
dtype=None/dropped on asarray/arange/empty still infers int64/float64 (stitch mut3,5,32,34; indices mut27,30,58,59,60,61,62; path_assignments mut30,32).

test_times and train_times are provably non-empty (groups non-empty, n_test_groups < n_groups), so `or`->`and` and `continue`->`break` at the non-empty guards are dead (cv mut62,65,70; indices mut63,68).
`(train_parts) or True` and np.empty(1) else-branch are dead — train_parts is always non-empty (indices mut56,62).
zip(strict=True) -> None/False/dropped is inert: purge_mask returns len(keep) == len(purged) by construction (cv mut88,91,92).
Embargo boundary flips at idx == lo or idx == hi are unreachable for train times — those indices are test-group elements already removed (cv mut100,106; indices mut85,86,89,94,101).
astype(np.int64, copy=None/False/True/dropped) produces identical values (indices mut114,116,117,119,121,122).

issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.datetime64) -> (None,·) or (·,None) both yield False for datetime64 arrays, taking the same per-element path (timestamp_ns mut10,11).
zip(strict=True) -> None/False/dropped is inert: upstream guards already enforce equal lengths (walk_forward mut20,23,24,83,86,87).
`end > previous` -> `>=` writes the same value when label_end_times repeat a timestamp (walk_forward mut33).
`tr_start = 0` -> None: `uniq[None:cursor]` equals `uniq[0:cursor]` (walk_forward mut54).
session_index=idx -> None rebuilds an order-identical index over the contiguous train block, yielding the same purge mask (walk_forward mut64,70).

`cursor = test_end if scheme == 'rolling' else test_end` is an identity conditional — every comparison variant still assigns test_end (mut99-103); `if scheme == 'expanding': pass` mutants are no-ops (mut104-106).

float('NAN') is the same value as float('nan') (fold_ic_stability mut21,26).

np.asarray(navs, dtype=None/dropped) still infers float64; np.zeros dtype=None for the CRC baseline likewise (mut14,16,190,192).

crc_es == _EPS exactly is unattainable from CRC-calibrated quantiles (mut209).
